Dr. Blumenstock on January 22 handed me
six glass veronal tubes of which one was full
and the others were empty. An examination
of the labels on these tubes affords grounds
for belief that they were made by Bayer & Co.,
Germany, and exported to Japan. Labels added
in Japan to four of the tubes indicate that
they were sold by retail in that country.
Each glass tube contained 10 tablets of
veronal of 0.5 g. The taking of five tablets
would be dangerous and the taking of ten
tablets or more would be almost sure to prove
fatal. With the aid of tea, a person
accustomed to swallowing medicine in tabloid
form could take forty tablets of veronal in
less than ten minutes. The four letters
left by Baroness de Pidoll were all short and
could have been written in less than 15
minutes. [ The letter to Charles Arnhold
which was dated "Nagasaki, January 18, 1931", ]

January 23, 1931.

Suicide of Baroness de Pidol.

Interview with Sir
Frederick Whyte in
Cathay Hotel on
forenoon of January
23, 1931.

Sir Frederick Whyte and Baroness de Pidol
left Shanghai about October 12. They arrived in
Japan on October 16 and remained there, with the
exception of short intervals when one or both
of them travelled to Shanghai, until January 16.
They first stopped at Kobe, but later visited
various other places, including Kobe, Nara,
Kyoto and Nagasaki. Soon after arriving in
Japan, it became obvious to both Sir Frederick
and the Baroness that they could not live
together. The Baroness pined for her husband,
and seemed to have a definite conviction that
life without him would be worthless. In brooding
over her cares and desires the Baroness frequently
underwent crisis of the emotions which had a
detrimental effect on her general health.
On December 30, Sir Frederick set out for
Shanghai leaving the Baroness alone in Kyoto
where he rejoined her on January 5. During
Sir Frederick's stay in Shanghai, he interviewed
Baron de Pidol and endeavoured to persuade him
to take the Baroness back. The Baron, however,
flatly refused to do so. Sir Frederick left
Shanghai with the belief that the Baron could
not be induced to alter his decision. On reflec-
tion, he however thought that further represen-
tations to the Baron might bring success or at
least keep the door open. Sir Frederick and
the Baroness discussed the matter, and decided
that a further effort to induce the Baron to
pages.zh:
1931年1月23日。

德·皮多尔男爵夫人自杀案。

1931年1月23日上午
在华懋饭店采访
弗雷德里克·怀特爵士。

弗雷德里克·怀特爵士与德·皮多尔男爵夫人
于10月12日左右离开上海。他们于10月16日抵达
日本，并一直停留在那里，除了一人或两人短暂
前往上海的间歇期外，直到1月16日。他们首先
在神户停留，但后来访问了包括神户、奈良、
京都和长崎在内的其他多个地方。抵达日本后不久，
怀特爵士和男爵夫人都明显感到他们无法共同生活。
男爵夫人思念她的丈夫，并且似乎坚定地认为，
没有他的生活毫无价值。在忧思其烦恼和愿望时，
男爵夫人经常经历情绪危机，这对她的整体健康
产生了不利影响。
12月30日，怀特爵士启程前往上海，将男爵夫人
独自留在京都，他于1月5日回到她身边。在怀特爵士
逗留上海期间，他会见了德·皮多尔男爵，并试图
说服他接回男爵夫人。然而，男爵断然拒绝这样做。
怀特爵士离开上海时认为，无法促使男爵改变决定。
但经过反思，他认为进一步向男爵陈述情况可能会
成功，或者至少保持沟通渠道畅通。怀特爵士和
男爵夫人讨论了此事，并决定再次努力促使男爵

pages.en:

change his mind would be practical. They
accordingly left Kobe together about January 8
and arrived in Shanghai about January 10. On
arriving here, Sir Frederick left the Baroness
on board the ship and went to call on the Baron.
Sir Frederick remained from 8 p.m. in the
evening until one o'clock in the morning pleading
with the Baron to take the Baroness back, but his
efforts proved fruitless. In his pleading Sir
Frederick pointed out that not only the future
happiness of the Baroness but even her chances
of living depended on the Baron's decision.
Sir Frederick and the Baroness left again for
Japan on January 11. After the ship sailed
it became obvious that the failure of the
mission to Shanghai had seriously aggravated
the condition of the Baroness, and this alarmed
Sir Frederick to such an extent that he decided
to return to Shanghai with the Baroness for
the purpose of obtaining the opinion of Dr.
Blumenstock about her, and incidentally using
the Doctor to convey to the Baron an independent
account of the condition of the Baroness in the
hope that the news might soften his heart.
Furthermore the Doctor was a friend of the Pidol
family and it was thought that pleading on his
part with the Baron might have the desired
effect. Sir Frederick, moreover, thought that
in view of the seriousness of the condition of
the Baroness it was his duty to put the whole
matter once more before the Baron. Sir Frederick
and the Baroness left Nagasaki on January 13
whence, after a stay of four hours, they returned
pages.zh:
- 2 -

改变主意是可行的。因此，他们于1月8日左右
一起离开神户，并于1月10日左右抵达上海。
抵达此处后，怀特爵士将男爵夫人留在船上，
前去拜访男爵。怀特爵士从晚上8点一直待到
凌晨1点，恳求男爵接回男爵夫人，但他的努力
证明是徒劳的。在恳求中，怀特爵士指出，不仅
男爵夫人未来的幸福，甚至她的生存机会都取决于
男爵的决定。怀特爵士和男爵夫人于1月11日再次
启程前往日本。船开后，显然上海之行的失败严重
加剧了男爵夫人的病情，这使怀特爵士极为震惊，
以至于他决定带男爵夫人返回上海，目的是征求
布卢门斯托克医生对她的意见，并顺便利用医生
向男爵传达关于男爵夫人状况的独立描述，希望
这一消息能软化他的心肠。此外，医生是皮多尔
家族的朋友，人们认为由他向男爵求情可能会产生
预期的效果。而且，怀特爵士认为，鉴于男爵夫人
病情的严重性，他有责任将整个事件再次提交给
男爵。怀特爵士和男爵夫人于1月13日离开长崎，
在那里停留四小时后，他们乘坐

pages.en:
- 3 -

to Japan by the same ship. While they were
in Shanghai, Dr. Blumenstock, who had been
summoned by wireless, came to the ship. Sir
Frederick explained to the Doctor the condition
of the Baroness, the immediate and pressing need
for inducing the Baron to change his attitude,
and the danger which would be involved in any
indiscreet move on the part of the Doctor which
would precipitate the Baron to take unfavourable
action, such as instituting immediate suit for
divorce. Dr. Blumenstock remained on board for
two hours. The conversation with him seemed to
raise the hopes of the Baroness, who when he
came on board smilingly greeted him saying :
"The telegram announcing that you would come
gave me more happiness than anything else that
had happened during the past three months".
The Doctor finally left saying that he would
approach the Baron and expressed a belief that
he would be able to set the situation right.

When the ship on which Sir Frederick
and the Baroness were travelling arrived back
in Nagasaki, the former received a telegram
which said "No result". As a result of a
consultation by the Baroness, who was very
depressed by this message, and Sir Frederick,
the latter dispatched a telegram to Dr. Blumen-
stock in the following sense :"Cannot believe
failure. If I come will you see me will be
greatest comfort". As there was nothing to
be done in Japan, Sir Frederick and the Baroness
decided to leave for Shanghai by a ship sailing
from Nagasaki at 1 p.m. on the afternoon of
pages.zh:
- 3 -

同一艘船返回日本。当他们在
上海时，应无线电召唤前来的布卢门斯托克医生
来到船上。怀特爵士向医生解释了男爵夫人的
状况、促使男爵改变态度的迫切需求，以及医生
任何轻率举动所涉及的 Danger，这种举动可能会
促使男爵采取不利行动，例如立即提起离婚诉讼。
布卢门斯托克医生在船上停留了两个小时。与他的
谈话似乎提升了男爵夫人的希望，当他上船时，
她微笑着迎接他说：“宣布你要来的电报给我的
快乐超过了过去三个月发生的任何其他事情”。
医生最后离开时说他将去接触男爵，并表示相信
他能够扭转局势。

当载有怀特爵士
和男爵夫人的船只返回
长崎时，前者收到一封
电报，内容是“没有结果”。由于这一消息，
男爵夫人非常沮丧，在与怀特爵士协商后，
后者向布卢门斯托克医生发送了一封大意如下的
电报：“无法相信失败。如果我回去，你会见我吗，
这将是我最大的安慰”。由于在日本无事可做，
怀特爵士和男爵夫人决定乘坐一艘于下午1点从
长崎启航的船只前往上海，时间是1月

pages.en:
- 4 -

January 17. When the ship was about to sail they
received the following telegram from Dr. Blumen-
stock : "Absolute failure, don't come".

Undaunted by this message Sir Frederick
on arriving in Shanghai about 3 p.m. January 18
telephoned to Dr. Blumenstock who arrived at the
ship shortly before 5 p.m. As Sir Frederick was
leaving the suite consisting of a sitting room
and a bed room, in which the Baroness was travelling,
he called for two cups of tea. When Dr. Blumen-
stock arrived on the ship, Sir Frederick took
him to the sitting room. While they were there
the Baroness came out into a passage way which
connected the sitting room and bed room. She
called from there for another cup of tea and
said "Is Dr. Blumenstock coming?" When Sir
Frederick replied that the Doctor had arrived,
she came into the sitting room, shook hands with
Dr. Blumenstock and expressed a wish to be left
alone with him. Sir Frederick retired to the
bed room and in doing so noticed that the voice
of the Baroness was somewhat shaken. After
having conversed for twenty or twenty five minutes
with the Baroness, Dr. Blumenstock joined Sir
Frederick and urged that they should both go back
to Japan. After this conversation, they went to
the sitting room where they found the Baroness
sitting on the couch with her head on her shoulder.
A hasty examination by Dr. Blumenstock showed
she had taken something. A search in the drawer
of a night table revealed four empty veronal
phials and two more phials of the same drug,
which were intact, were found in the pocket of a
woollen jumper which the Baroness was wearing.
pages.zh:
- 4 -

17日下午。当船即将启航时，他们
收到了布卢门斯托克医生的如下电报：“彻底
失败，不要来”。

未被此消息吓倒的怀特爵士
于1月18日下午3点左右抵达上海后，
致电布卢门斯托克医生，医生在下午5点前
不久到达船上。当怀特爵士离开由客厅和
卧室组成的套房（男爵夫人旅途中居住于此）时，
他要了两杯茶。当布卢门斯托克医生到达船上时，
怀特爵士带他去了客厅。当他们在那里时，
男爵夫人从连接客厅和卧室的过道里出来。
她从那里又要了一杯茶，并说“布卢门斯托克
医生来了吗？”当怀特爵士回答说医生已经到了，
她走进客厅，与布卢门斯托克医生握手，并表示
希望能与他单独相处。怀特爵士退到卧室，在此
过程中注意到男爵夫人的声音有些颤抖。在与
男爵夫人交谈了二十或二十五分钟后，布卢门斯托克
医生加入怀特爵士，并敦促他们两人都回日本。
这次谈话后，他们去了客厅，发现男爵夫人
坐在沙发上，头靠在肩膀上。布卢门斯托克医生
匆忙检查后发现她服用了某种药物。在床头柜的
抽屉里搜查发现了四个空的佛罗那药瓶，另外两瓶
同样的药物完好无损，是在男爵夫人穿着的一件
羊毛套衫的口袋里找到的。

pages.en:
- 5 -

After some discussion it was decided to take
the Baroness to the Country Hospital in Dr.
Blumenstock's motor car. After rendering first
aid to the Baroness there Dr. Blumenstock
decided to summon her husband, Baron de Pidol,
and Sir Frederick left.

Sir Frederick Whyte distinctly remembers
that when the Baroness came into the passage
asking for a cup of tea she had an empty cup
in her hand.

Sir Frederick does not know when the
Baroness wrote the letters which, according to
the newspapers, she left behind.

So far as Sir Frederick knows the
Baroness did not at any time consult a physician
in Japan.

About Xmas Sir Frederick found the
Baroness in possession of two phials of veronal.
Although she made light of the matter saying
that she took veronal tablets from time to time
as a sleeping draught, Sir Frederick decided
to take them away from her. Sir Frederick
cannot explain where the Baroness obtained the
veronal phials found in her room. He presumes
she purchased them in Japan.

Sir Frederick remarked that the Baroness
took a good deal of Bromural while they were
in Japan.

A letter from the Baroness to Sir
Frederick Whyte which has been delivered by
Dr. Blumenstock, reads as follows :

"Goodbye, I am sorry for you. I forgive
you everything. I hope you will live in peace.
Paulette".
pages.zh:
- 5 -

经过一番讨论，决定用布卢门斯托克医生的
汽车将男爵夫人送往乡村医院。在那里对男爵夫人
进行急救后，布卢门斯托克医生决定召唤她的丈夫
德·皮多尔男爵，怀特爵士随即离开。

弗雷德里克·怀特爵士清楚地记得，
当男爵夫人走进过道要一杯茶时，她手里拿着
一个空杯子。

怀特爵士不知道男爵夫人何时写了据报纸
报道她留下的那些信件。

据怀特爵士所知，男爵夫人在日本期间
从未咨询过医生。

大约在圣诞节期间，怀特爵士发现男爵夫人
持有两瓶佛罗那。虽然她对此事轻描淡写，说她
偶尔服用佛罗那药片作为安眠药，但怀特爵士决定
将其没收。怀特爵士无法解释在她房间里发现的
佛罗那药瓶是从何处获得的。他推测她是在日本
购买的。

怀特爵士提到，男爵夫人在日本期间
服用了大量的溴姆拉（Bromural）。

布卢门斯托克医生转交的一封男爵夫人致
弗雷德里克·怀特爵士的信，内容如下：

“再见，我为你感到难过。我原谅你的一切。
我希望你能平静地生活。
波莱特”。

pages.en:
Suicide of Baroness de Fidol.

Interview with Dr.
Blumenstock on January
24, 1931.

In answer to a radio message, Dr.
Blumenstock went to the "Shanghai Maru" on
January 15. He there met Sir Frederick Whyte
who having introduced himself as the man who
went away with Baroness de Fidol, stated that
the lady in question was on board the ship and
needed a physician's attention. Sir Frederick
further explained that both he and the Baroness
had made a mistake in going away and both
realized this fact on the first day they were
together. He added that the Baroness wished to
go back to her husband. Dr. Blumenstock then
went to see the Baroness who cried and explained
her anxiety to go to the Baron. She explained
that the latter was the only man she ever loved.
Dr. Blumenstock promised that he would tell the
Baron about her state and telegraph the result
to Nagasaki. The doctor fulfilled this
promise the same afternoon but failed to achieve
anything. He telegraphed accordingly to
Nagasaki. The telegram which was in German
consisted of the words "No result". The
telegram was sent about January 16 and a reply
came saying "Cannot believe. Will come to
Shanghai". The Doctor sent a second telegram
saying "Absolute Failure. Don't come".

About 3.30 p.m. on Sunday, January 18,
Dr. Blumenstock received a telephone message
from Sir Frederick Whyte saying that his services
as a Doctor were required on the "Nagasaki Maru".
The Doctor went immediately to the ship and on
arrival there found Sir Frederick waiting on
deck. Sir Frederick told Dr. Blumenstock that
pages.zh:
菲多尔男爵夫人（Baroness de Fidol）自杀案。

1931年1月24日会见布鲁门斯托克医生（Dr. Blumenstock）。

应无线电报之请，布鲁门斯托克医生于1月15日前往“上海丸”号（Shanghai Maru）。他在那里会见了弗雷德里克·怀特爵士（Sir Frederick Whyte），后者自我介绍称是随菲多尔男爵夫人一同离开的人，并指出该女士在船上，需要医生诊治。弗雷德里克爵士进一步解释说，他和男爵夫人在离家出走一事上都犯了错误，两人在共同生活的第一天就意识到了这一事实。他补充说，男爵夫人希望回到丈夫身边。随后，布鲁门斯托克医生去见男爵夫人，她哭着解释了自己急于回到男爵身边的焦虑心情。她解释说，男爵是她唯一爱过的男人。布鲁门斯托克医生承诺会将她的状况告知男爵，并将结果电告长崎。医生当天下午便履行了这一承诺，但未能取得任何成效。他随即向长崎发送了电报。该电报以德文写成，内容仅为“无结果”（No result）。电报约于1月16日发出，收到的回复称：“难以置信。将赴上海”。医生又发出第二封电报，称：“彻底失败。勿来”。

1月18日，星期日，下午约3点30分，布鲁门斯托克医生接到弗雷德里克·怀特爵士的电话留言，称“长崎丸”号（Nagasaki Maru）上需要他的医疗服务。医生立即前往该船，抵达后发现弗雷德里克爵士正在甲板上等候。弗雷德里克爵士告诉布鲁门斯托克医生，

pages.en:
- 2 -

Baroness de Pidol was in a desperate state and
had for two days been talking about committing
suicide. Sir Frederick said that he would not
dare to leave her for five minutes and added
that she was not aware that he had called the
doctor. Having brought the doctor to the cabin
de luxe in which Baroness de Pidol was travelling,
Sir Frederick went into the bedroom and engaged
in a conversation. After a few minutes he
returned with a large envelope which he handed to
Dr. Blumenstock to whom it was addressed. On
opening the envelope Dr. Blumenstock found it
contained four letters, one addressed to Baron
de Fidol, one to Charles Arnhold, one to Sir
Frederick Whyte and one to himself. All the
addresses were in the handwriting of Baroness de
Pidol. On opening the letter addressed to him,
Sir Frederick began to cry. In the meantime the
doctor read the letter addressed to himself which
consisted of a few words of thanks for what
he had done for the Baroness and an intimation
that the Baroness did not wish to live any longer
and wanted to be buried in Shanghai in order to
be near to her husband. As Dr. Blumenstock
finished the letter, the Baroness came into the
room. She was quite collected and the doctor
tried to console her saying "Be patient . Every-
thing will turn out all right". The Doctor and
the Baroness then sat down side by side on a
sofa in the sitting room and the Baroness requested
Sir Frederick Whyte to go out of the room saying
"I want to talk alone with the Doctor" The
Baroness then told Dr. Blumenstock that if he
tried to prevent her doing something now, she

皮多尔男爵夫人（Baroness de Pidol）处于绝望状态，且两天来一直谈论自杀。弗雷德里克爵士表示，他不敢离开她哪怕五分钟，并补充说她并不知道是他叫来了医生。弗雷德里克爵士将医生带到皮多尔男爵夫人所乘坐的豪华客舱后，进入卧室进行交谈。几分钟后，他拿着一个大信封出来，交给布鲁门斯托克医生，信封上是写给医生的地址。布鲁门斯托克医生打开信封，发现里面装有四封信，一封写给菲多尔男爵（Baron de Fidol），一封写给查尔斯·阿诺德（Charles Arnhold），一封写给弗雷德里克·怀特爵士，还有一封写给他自己。所有地址均为皮多尔男爵夫人的笔迹。在拆开写给他的信时，弗雷德里克爵士开始哭泣。与此同时，医生阅读了写给自己的信，信中只有寥寥数语，感谢他为男爵夫人所做的一切，并暗示男爵夫人已不想再活下去，希望葬在上海，以便离丈夫更近。当布鲁门斯托克医生读完信时，男爵夫人走进房间。她神情相当镇定，医生试图安慰她，说道：“耐心点。一切都会好起来的。”随后，医生和男爵夫人在起居室的沙发上并排坐下，男爵夫人请弗雷德里克·怀特爵士离开房间，说道：“我想单独和医生谈谈。”接着，男爵夫人告诉布鲁门斯托克医生，如果他试图阻止她现在做某事，她

would do it later on. She also said that she
loved her husband and nobody else and since
he had refused to take her back, it was no
use for her to live any longer. The Baroness
then apparently becoming tired, lent back on
the pillow of the sofa. Dr. Blumenstock took
her pulse which appeared to be normal. She
then closed her eyes as if she weregoing to sleep.
Being suspicious, Dr. Blumenstock opened the
eyelids and saw that the pupils had become
contracted and the reflex of the cornea had
almost disappeared. The Doctor then put the
Baroness down on the sofa and called to Whyte
from the outside corridor. The doctor then
explained to Sir Frederick that he felt sure the
Baroness had taken something. Sir Frederick
searched the pockets of a woollen jumper which
the Baroness was wearing and found a glass tube
full of veronal tablets. The search was continued
in the bedroom where five glass veronal tubes were
found. The doctor put these into his pocket and
returned with Sir Frederick Whyte to the sitting
room. The doctor and Sir Fredrick then decided
to take the Baroness, who had gone into a state
of coma, to the Country Hospital where she died
four days later without recovering consciousness.
Dr. Blumenstock is convinced beyond all doubt
that her death is due to veronal poisoning.
The doctor tried to save the life of the Baroness
by the usual remedies, but without success.
While Dr. Blumenstock was talking in the sitting
room, the Baroness said nothing to indicate that
she had taken poison. According to the opinion
of Dr. Blumenstock, a period of twenty minutes

以后也会去做。她还说，她爱她的丈夫，不爱其他人，既然丈夫拒绝接纳她回去，她活着也没有意义了。随后，男爵夫人似乎感到疲倦，靠在沙发的枕头上。布鲁门斯托克医生为她把脉，脉搏看似正常。然后她闭上眼睛，仿佛要入睡。出于怀疑，布鲁门斯托克医生翻开她的眼睑，发现瞳孔已经收缩，角膜反射几乎消失。医生随后将男爵夫人平放在沙发上，并从外面的走廊呼叫怀特。医生随即向弗雷德里克爵士解释，他确信男爵夫人服用了某种药物。弗雷德里克爵士搜查了男爵夫人穿着的一件羊毛套头衫的口袋，发现了一个装满维罗那（veronal，即巴比妥）药片的玻璃管。随后在卧室内继续搜查，又发现了五个装有维罗那的玻璃管。医生将这些放入自己的口袋，并与弗雷德里克·怀特爵士返回起居室。医生和弗雷德里克爵士随后决定将已进入昏迷状态的男爵夫人送往乡村医院（Country Hospital），她在四天后去世，期间从未恢复意识。布鲁门斯托克医生毫无疑问地确信，她的死因是维罗那中毒。医生尝试用常规方法挽救男爵夫人的生命，但未成功。在布鲁门斯托克医生于起居室谈话期间，男爵夫人未发一言表明她已服毒。根据布鲁门斯托克医生的意见，从服用维罗那到药效发作，间隔了二十分钟

elapsed from the time the veronal was taken until
it took effect. It would probably take a person
6 or 7 minutes to swallow 40 tablets of veronal.
Dr. Blumenstock has been physician to the de Ridol
family since the Summer of 1930 and is practically
sure that the Baroness was not addicted to drug
taking.
Dr. Blumenstock states that the Baroness
de Pldoll in her interviews with him spoke in an
appreciative manner of how kind Sir Frederick
Whyte had been to her. She always spoke well of
Sir Frederick, and never made any complaint of
any kind about his conduct to her.

THE OSAKA MAINICHI. & THE TOKYO NICHI NICHI, OSAKA, THURSDAY, JANUARY 15, 1931

British Ex-Official's Trips
Puzzle Nagasaki Police

Authorities Interested in
Movements

NAGASAKI, Jan. 14.—The police
here are watching with keen interest
on a former British high official of
the Indian Government and his wife
who have made three trips back and
between here and Shanghai since
January 5. Secret political man-
oeuvring is suspected.

On the passenger lists of the two
N.Y.K. transit liners to Shang-
hai, the Shanghai Maru and Nagasaki
Maru, the couple in question gave
their names as Mr. and Mrs. A. S.
White, 52 and 46 years of age, re-
spectively. An investigation revealed
that the man was Mr. Alex-
ander **〔此处转录不清〕** White, who once held
a high position in the Indian Govern-
ment.

Mr. White declined to say anything
to the Mainichi about his and his
wife's frequent comings and goings
between here and China. He only
said, "It is all for a private purpose.
If you want to hear anything further
about me, I would suggest that you
go to the British Embassy in To-
kyo." They had been staying at the
Miyako Hotel, Kyoto, until recently.

On January 5, the couple sailed
from here for Shanghai by the Shang-
hai Maru and returned here by the
same boat on January 8. The next
day, they again went to Shanghai by
the Nagasaki Maru and came back
here by the same ship on January 12
and although they had through tickets
to Kobe, landed here and stayed over-
night at the **〔此处转录不清〕** Hotel. For the
third time, the British **〔此处转录不清〕** left for
China today by the Shanghai Maru.

英国前官员的行踪
令长崎警方困惑

当局关注其动向

长崎，1月14日电——当地警方正密切关注一位前印度政府英国高级官员及其妻子，自1月5日以来，他们在此地与上海之间往返三次。涉嫌秘密政治活动。

在两艘往返上海的日本邮船会社（N.Y.K.）过境班轮“上海丸”号和“长崎丸”号的乘客名单上，这对夫妇登记的名字为A. S. 怀特先生和夫人，年龄分别为52岁和46岁。调查显示，该男子是亚历山大·**〔此处转录不清〕**·怀特先生，他曾在印度政府担任高职。

怀特先生拒绝向《每日新闻》透露他和妻子频繁往来于此地与中国之间的原因。他只说：“这纯属私人目的。如果您想进一步了解我的情况，建议您去东京的英国大使馆。”他们此前一直住在京都的都酒店（Miyako Hotel）。

1月5日，这对夫妇乘“上海丸”号从此地启航前往上海，并于1月8日乘同一艘船返回此地。次日，他们再次乘“长崎丸”号前往上海，并于1月12日乘同一艘船返回此地，尽管他们持有直达神户的联程票，但仍在此地下船，并在**〔此处转录不清〕**酒店过夜。第三次，这位英国**〔此处转录不清〕**今天乘“上海丸”号前往中国。

North China Daily News - January 24, 1931.

INQUEST ON LATE
BARONESS PIDOL

Death Due to Veronal,
Self Administered

At the inquest on the late
Baroness de Pidol which was held
yesterday at the Belgian Consulate-
General a verdict of suicide by
veronal poisoning was returned.
Mr. Rene Guillaume (First Vice-
Consul), assisted by Mr. L. J. Colot
(Second Vice-Consul), conducted the
inquest.
Medical evidence was given by
Dr. Blumenstock, who said that he
had attended the Baroness at the
Country Hospital until her death
about 8 a.m. on Thursday morning.
She was suffering from the effects
of swallowing a large quantity of
veronal—probably the contents of
three tubes—and did not regain
consciousness after her removal
from the N.Y.K.S. Nagasaki Maru
on Sunday. It was thought on the
day before her death that she was
recovering, but heart failure set in.
The funeral will be held at the
Hungjao Road Cemetery at 3 p.m.
to-morrow, the cortege leaving the
~~parlours of the International Funer-~~
al Directors, Kiaochow Road.

《字林西报》 - 1931年1月24日。

已故皮多尔男爵夫人
死因验尸

死于自行服用维罗那

昨日在比利时总领事馆举行的已故菲多尔男爵夫人（Baroness de Pidol）死因验尸会上，裁定其死于维罗那中毒自杀。勒内·纪尧姆先生（Rene Guillaume，第一副领事）主持了验尸，L. J. 科洛特先生（L. J. Colot，第二副领事）协助。

布鲁门斯托克医生提供了医学证据，他表示他一直照料男爵夫人直至她于周四上午约8点在乡村医院去世。她因吞服大量维罗那——可能是三支管的内容物——而受苦，自周日从日本邮船会社“长崎丸”号被抬下后，再未恢复意识。在她去世前一天，人们曾认为她正在康复，但随后发生心力衰竭。葬礼将于明天下午3点在虹桥路公墓举行，送葬队伍将从胶州路国际殡仪馆~~礼堂~~出发。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS, MONDAY, JUNE 18, 1934.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. M. D 5265 Date 20 / 1 KLL）

SIR FREDK. WHYTE
ARRIVES

Former Adviser to Nanking
Government Here

Sir Frederick and Lady Whyte, who
are well known in China, arrived
yesterday in the P. & O. ss. Rajputana.
They are staying at the present time
in the Astor House Hotel.

Sir Frederick has had a distin-
guished career which included over
two years as adviser to the Nanking
Government, from 1929 to 1932.
Born in Kirkcaldy in 1868, he was
educated in Scotland, taking his
M. A. degree in Edinburgh. He first
entered the public eye as member of
Parliament for Perth City, serving in
that capacity until 1918.

The greater part of his life since
that time has been spent abroad,
mainly in the United States and in
India. In the latter country he was
President of the Legislative Assemb-
ly from 1920 until 1925. In succeed-
ing years he spent much time in
North America and received honor-
ary degrees from several universi-
ties including McGill, Michigan and
Dartmouth. He also received an
honorary LL.D. from Edinburgh Uni-
versity in 1924.

In 1929 he came to China as ad-
viser to the Nanking Government,
which post he kept until 1932. He
has written several books of note,
among which are "Asia in the Twen-
tieth Century," "China and Foreign
Powers," and "The Future of East
and West."

弗雷德里克·怀特爵士
抵达

前南京政府顾问抵沪

在中国广为人知的弗雷德里克·怀特爵士和怀特夫人昨日乘半岛与东方轮船公司（P. & O.）的“拉杰普塔纳”号（ss. Rajputana）抵达。他们目前住在汇中饭店（Astor House Hotel）。

弗雷德里克爵士拥有辉煌的职业生涯，其中包括1929年至1932年间担任南京政府顾问两年多。他于1868年出生于柯科迪（Kirkcaldy），在苏格兰接受教育，并在爱丁堡获得文学硕士学位。他最初作为珀斯市（Perth City）议员进入公众视野，任职至1918年。

此后的大部分时间他都在国外度过，主要在美国和印度。在印度，他于1920年至1925年担任立法议会主席。在随后的几年里，他在北美度过了大量时间，并从包括麦吉尔大学、密歇根大学和达特茅斯学院在内的多所大学获得了荣誉学位。他还于1924年获得爱丁堡大学颁发的荣誉法学博士学位。

1929年，他来到中国担任南京政府顾问，该职位一直保留到1932年。他撰写了几本著名的书籍，其中包括《二十世纪之亚洲》、《中国与列强》以及《东西方的未来》。

（批：归档）

BARON CHARLES DE PIDOLL.
                                        Shanghai, January 22nd 1931
                                        1331 Route Lafayette
                                        Tel. 70115.
                Blackstone Apartments
                        No. 32.

                                J.F. Brenan C.M.G.
                                H.B.M. Consul General
                                S H A N G H A I.

Sir,

    Sunday the 18th of this month my wife, Baroness de Pidoll,
formerly Paulette de Herz-Hertenried of Vienna, poisoned herself
by deglutition of a strong dose of Veronal.    She is, at the
present moment, at the Country Hospital, Shanghai, under medical
care of Dr. G. Blumenstock of Shanghai, Yu Yuen Road 173.    Her
chances for recovery are but very remote.

    As the circumstances under which these tragic happenings
occurred, seem to point out that the responsibility, under British
Law, of a British subject is involved.

    As, furthermore, in spite of the fact, that my wife has left
me and my home definitely and in full knowledge that in doing so
she forfeited the right ever to come back there, on October 12th
1930, a decree of divorce has not yet been granted to me.

    It is my legal duty to inform you of the facts having a bear-
ing on this case.

    My wife left Shanghai, on October 12th 1930, with Sir Frederick
Whyte, K.C.S.I., well known to you, and the full responsibility
of the latter for her welfare, since October 12th 1930, has never
been denied by him, to my knowledge.

    In fact, Sir Frederick Whyte is proved to have fully under-
taken that responsibility by the following circumstances:

    a) once, shortly before Xmas 1930, a second time a fortnight
later, beginning of January 1931, Sir Frederick Whyte has secret-
ly visited me in Shanghai, Route Lafayette 1331, on both occas-
ions beseeching me to allow my wife to come back to me, so he
said, if I persisted to refuse to grant this request, she was very
likely to commit suicide, owing to the fact that she deeply re-
gretted to have left me and that her state of mind was bordering
the insane.

    b) Thursday, the 15th of January 1931 Sir Frederick Whyte
arrived a third time in Shanghai harbour from Japan, this time
accompanied by Baroness de Pidoll.    The day before Dr. Blumen-
stock of Shanghai had received a telegram from Whyte with the
request to meet Whyte on the boat at her arrival.    Blumenstock
complied.    Whyte described to Blumenstock the highly strung state
of mind of Baroness de Pidoll, pointing out to Blumenstock his
(Whyte's) fears of a possible attempt to suicide and requested
Blumenstock to form a professional opinion of the case with a view
to see me after and try favourably to impress me towards forgive-
ness for my wife.

先生：

    本月18日（星期日），我的妻子皮多尔男爵夫人，即原维也纳的波莱特·德·赫兹-赫滕里德（Paulette de Herz-Hertenried），吞服大剂量佛罗那（Veronal）自杀。目前，她正在上海乡村医院（Country Hospital, Shanghai）接受上海愚园路173号的G. 布卢门斯托克医生（Dr. G. Blumenstock）的医治。她的康复希望极为渺茫。

    鉴于这一悲剧发生的情况似乎表明，根据英国法律，涉及一名英国臣民的责任问题。

    此外，尽管我的妻子已于1930年10月12日明确离开我和我们的家，且完全知晓此举将使她丧失永远返回此处的权利，但至今尚未向我颁发离婚判决书。

    我有法律义务向您通报与本案有关的事实。

    我的妻子于1930年10月12日随弗雷德里克·怀特爵士（Sir Frederick Whyte），K.C.S.I.勋衔持有者（阁下对他很熟悉）离开上海。据我所知，他从未否认过自1930年10月12日以来对我妻子福祉所负的全部责任。

    事实上，以下情况证明弗雷德里克·怀特爵士已完全承担了该责任：

    a) 一次是在1930年圣诞节前不久，另一次是两周后，即1931年1月初，弗雷德里克·怀特爵士曾两次秘密到上海辣斐德路1331号拜访我，在这两次拜访中，他都恳求我允许我的妻子回到我身边。他说，如果我坚持拒绝这一请求，她很可能会自杀，因为她对离开我深感后悔，且其精神状态已接近疯狂。

    b) 1931年1月15日（星期四），弗雷德里克·怀特爵士第三次从日本抵达上海港，这次由皮多尔男爵夫人陪同。前一天，上海的布卢门斯托克医生收到怀特发来的电报，要求他在船抵港时与怀特会面。布卢门斯托克照办了。怀特向布卢门斯托克描述了皮多尔男爵夫人高度紧张的精神状态，并向布卢门斯托克指出他（怀特）对可能发生自杀企图的担忧，并请求布卢门斯托克就此案形成专业意见，以便随后见我，并试图有利地影响我，使我原谅我的妻子。

c) Sunday the 18th of January 1931 Blumenstock was again summoned by Whyte, by telephone, at about 3:30 p.m. to come and see him on board a ship, on which he (Whyte) and Baroness de Pidoll had just arrived from Japan. Whyte received Blumenstock with the statement that Baroness de Pidoll's state of mind had become so highly dangerous with regard to suicide that he (Whyte) did not dare to leave her alone even for five minutes, and that, consequently he (Whyte) had again come over to Shanghai in order to hand the patient and the case to his (Blumenstock's) professional care.

The further facts of the case are stated by Dr. Blumenstock to have been found thus by him:

Proceeding to see Baroness de Pidoll, he found the patient apparently normal and became aware, but after a few minutes of conversation with her, that something serious had actually happened. She lost consciousness and certain symptoms revealed to Blumenstock that Veronal had been taken. He found in the cabin

a) four empty glass-tubes of Veronal having contained 10 tablets of 7 grains, each,
b) three letters, written by Baroness de Pidoll to Dr. Blumenstock, to C.H. Arnhold, to myself, respectively.

Blumenstock undertook immediately the medical steps likely to save Baroness de Pidoll's life. The further development of the case proved that Blumenstock's initial surmise was right: it is a poisoning with a very strong dose of Veronal. The deglutition of the poison had taken place, according to Blumenstock, from 10 to 30 minutes before his (Blumenstock's) arrival on board.

If Sir Frederick Whyte is to be acquitted of criminal negligence in this case, it seems that the following questions must be satisfactorily answered by him:

a) if, as stated by himself, he came to Shanghai with the patient because of his conviction that he was not anymore able to handle the case himself and in order to hand her over to medical care - how is it that he came, during the last thirty minutes of his responsibility, to relax his watch on the patient to the extent of giving her the possibility not only to swallow the poison after having dissolved it in hot tea, but also to write three post mortem letters, without his knowledge?

b) How is it, that the patient, who has never been a drug-addict of any kind, found herself in possession of 40 tablets of Veronal - in fact, a quantity of which one fourth is lethal - at such a moment and under such circumstances?

c) Where and when and by whom was this poison procured? Under which physician's prescription?

I wish to state that I have written you the present letter with the only object to safeguard my own responsibilities in the case. It is for this reason that I have ventured to address you rather than the Crown Advocate. If I omitted to make the statements contained in this letter to a British official, not only

    c) 1931年1月18日（星期日）下午约3点30分，布卢门斯托克再次接到怀特的电话召唤，要求他到一艘船上去见他，他（怀特）和皮多尔男爵夫人刚刚从日本抵达该船。怀特接待布卢门斯托克时称，皮多尔男爵夫人的精神状态在自杀方面已变得极其危险，以至于他（怀特）甚至不敢让她单独待五分钟，因此，他（怀特）再次来到上海，是为了将病人及此案移交给他的（布卢门斯托克的）专业护理。

    据布卢门斯托克医生陈述，本案的进一步事实是他这样发现的：

    他去见皮多尔男爵夫人时，发现病人表面正常，但在与她交谈几分钟后，意识到确实发生了严重的事情。她失去了知觉，某些症状向布卢门斯托克显示她服用了佛罗那。他在舱房内发现：

    a) 四支空的佛罗那玻璃管，每支原装有10片药片，每片7格令（grains），
    b) 三封信，分别由皮多尔男爵夫人写给布卢门斯托克医生、C.H. 阿诺尔德（C.H. Arnhold）以及我自己。

    布卢门斯托克立即采取了可能挽救皮多尔男爵夫人生命的医疗措施。案件的进一步发展证明布卢门斯托克最初的推测是正确的：这是大剂量佛罗那中毒。据布卢门斯托克称，毒物的吞服发生在他（布卢门斯托克）登船前的10至30分钟内。

    如果要免除弗雷德里克·怀特爵士在此案中的刑事过失责任，看来必须由他令人满意地回答以下问题：

    a) 如果如他自己所述，他带病人来上海是因为他确信自己已无法再处理此案，并为了将其移交给医疗护理——那么，在他负责的最后三十分钟内，他是如何放松对病人的监视，以至于不仅使她有机会在将毒药溶于热茶后吞下，而且还在他不知情的情况下写了三封遗书？

    b) 这位从未有过任何药物成瘾史的病人，是如何在这样的时刻和情况下拥有40片佛罗那的——事实上，其中四分之一的数量即可致死？

    c) 这种毒药是在何处、何时、由谁 procured（获取/购买）的？依据哪位医生的处方？

    我要声明，我写这封信的唯一目的是保护我在本案中的自身责任。正是出于这个原因，我才冒昧致函阁下，而非皇家检察官（Crown Advocate）。如果我未向一位英国官员作出本信所载的陈述，不仅

Yours faithfully,
(Sgd) Charles de Pidoll.

Interview with Sir

Sir Frederick Whyte and Baroness de Fidol
left Shanghai about October 12.They arrived in
Japan on October 16 and remained there, with the
exception of short intervals when one or both of
them traveled to Shanghai, until January 16,1931.
They first stopped at Kobe, but later visited
various other places, including Kobe, Nara,
Kyoto and Nagasaki. Soon after arriving in
Japan, it became obvious to both Sir Frederick
and the Baroness that they could not live
together. The Baroness pined for her husband,
and seemed to have a definite conviction that
life without him would be worthless. In brooding
over her cares and desires the Baroness frequently
underwent crisis of the emotions which had a
detrimental effect on her general health. On
December 30, Sir Frederick set out for
Shanghai leaving the Baroness alone in Kyoto
where he rejoined her on January 5. During
Sir Frederick's stay in Shanghai, he interviewed
Baron de Fidol and endeavoured to persuade him
to take the Baroness back. The Baron, however,
flatly refused to do so. Sir Frederick left
Shanghai with the belief that the Baron could
not be induced to alter his decision. On reflec-
tion he however thought that further representa-
tions to the Baron might bring success or at
least keep the door open. Sir Frederick and
the Baroness discussed the matter, and decided
that a further effort to induce the Baron to

弗雷德里克·怀特爵士和菲多尔男爵夫人（Baroness de Fidol）
于10月12日左右离开上海。他们于10月16日抵达
日本，并一直停留在那里，除了其中一人或两人
前往上海的短暂间歇外，直到1931年1月16日。
他们首先停留在神户，但后来访问了其他各个地方，包括神户、奈良、
京都和长崎。抵达日本后不久，弗雷德里克爵士
和男爵夫人都明显感到他们无法共同生活。男爵夫人
思念她的丈夫，并且似乎坚定地认为，没有他的
生活将毫无价值。在忧思她的烦恼和愿望时，男爵夫人
经常经历情绪危机，这对她的整体健康产生了
不利影响。12月30日，弗雷德里克爵士启程前往

回到她身边。在弗雷德里克爵士逗留上海期间，他会见了
菲多尔男爵（Baron de Fidol），并试图说服他
接回男爵夫人。然而，男爵断然拒绝这样做。弗雷德里克爵士
离开上海时认为，无法诱使男爵改变决定。但经
过反思，他认为进一步向男爵交涉可能会成功，或至少
保持大门敞开。弗雷德里克爵士和

obvious that the failure of the mission to Shanghai
had seriously aggravated the condition of the

using the Doctor to convey to the Baron an independent

hope that the news might soften his heart.

family and it was thought that pleading on his
part with the Baron might have the desired
effect. Sir Frederick, moreover, thought that in
view of the seriousness of the condition of the

- 1月17日。当轮船即将启航时，他们收到了布卢门斯托克博士（Dr. Blumenstock）发来的如下电报：“彻底失败，勿来”。

弗雷德里克爵士（Sir Frederick）并未因这一消息而气馁，他于1月18日下午3点左右抵达上海后，致电布卢门斯托克博士，后者于下午5点前不久抵达轮船。当弗雷德里克爵士离开由一间起居室和一间卧室组成的套房（男爵夫人即在此旅行）时，他吩咐准备两杯茶。当布卢门斯托克博士登上轮船时，弗雷德里克爵士将他带至起居室。当他们在那里时，男爵夫人从连接起居室和卧室的通道中走出来。她从那里喊道再要一杯茶，并问道：“布卢门斯托克博士来了吗？”当弗雷德里克爵士回答说医生已经到了，她便走进起居室，与布卢门斯托克博士握手，并表示希望与他单独相处。弗雷德里克爵士退至卧室，在此过程中注意到男爵夫人的声音有些颤抖。在与男爵夫人交谈了二十或二十五分钟后，布卢门斯托克博士来到弗雷德里克爵士身边，极力主张他们两人都返回日本。谈话结束后，他们回到起居室，发现男爵夫人坐在沙发上，头靠在肩上。布卢门斯托克博士迅速检查后显示她服用了某种药物。在床头柜的抽屉里搜查发现了四个空的维罗那（veronal）空瓶，另外两瓶同样的药物完好无损，是在男爵夫人所穿的一件羊毛套头衫的口袋里发现的。

take the Baroness to the Country Hospital in Dr.
Blumenstock's motor car. After rendering first aid
to the Baroness there Dr. Blumenstock decided to
summon herhusband, Baron de Pidol, and Sir

Sir Frederick Whyte distinctly remembers that
when the Baroness came into the passage asking
for a cup of tea she had an empty cup in her hand.

Sir Frederick does not know when the
Baroness wrote the letters which according to the
newspapers she left behind.

So far as Sir Frederick knows the Baroness
did not at any time consult a physician in Japan.

About Xmas Sir Frederick found the Baroness
in possession of two phials of veronal. Although
she made light of the matter saying that she took
veronal tablets from time to time as a sleeping
draught, Sir Frederick decided to take them away
from her. Sir Frederick cannot explain where the
Baroness obtained the veronal phials found in her room.
He presumes she purchased them in Japan.

Sir Frederick remarked that the Baroness
took a good deal of Bromural while they were in
Japan.

A letter from the Baroness to Sir Frederick
Whyte which has been delivered by Dr. Blumenstock
reads as follows :

"Goodbye, I am sorry for you. I forgive
you everything. I hope you will live in peace.
Paulette".

经过一番讨论，决定用布卢门斯托克博士的汽车将男爵夫人送往乡村医院（Country Hospital）。在那里对男爵夫人进行急救后，布卢门斯托克博士决定召唤她的丈夫皮多尔男爵（Baron de Pidol），随后弗雷德里克爵士离开。

弗雷德里克·怀特爵士（Sir Frederick Whyte）清楚地记得，当男爵夫人走进通道索要一杯茶时，她手里拿着一个空杯子。

弗雷德里克爵士不知道男爵夫人何时写了据报纸称她留下的那些信件。

据弗雷德里克爵士所知，男爵夫人在日本期间从未咨询过医生。

大约在圣诞节期间，弗雷德里克爵士发现男爵夫人持有两瓶维罗那。尽管她对此事轻描淡写，称她偶尔服用维罗那片剂作为安眠药，但弗雷德里克爵士决定将其没收。弗雷德里克爵士无法解释在她房间里发现的维罗那瓶子是从何处获得的。他推测她是她在日本购买的。

弗雷德里克爵士指出，男爵夫人在日本期间服用了大量的溴姆拉（Bromural）。

布卢门斯托克博士转交的一封男爵夫人写给弗雷德里克·怀特爵士的信内容如下：

“再见，我为你感到难过。我原谅你的一切。希望你生活安宁。
波莱特（Paulette）。”

就维罗那在日本的销售情况进行的查询显示，在日本，药店可以向持有医生处方的人出售维罗那，也可以向任何能就其购买该药物的原因提供令人满意解释的人出售。

M Umemoto
